stem.text: A potentiometer circuit is used to investigate the electromotive force (e.m.f.) of a cell X.

stem.alt: Potentiometer circuit: a driver cell labelled 2.0 V connected across a resistance wire between ends Q and R, with a sliding contact at P, a galvanometer, and cell X.

stem.text: The e.m.f. of cell X is known to be approximately $0.50\,\text{V}$.

The driver cell has negligible internal resistance and an e.m.f. of $2.0\,\text{V}$. The sliding contact is moved along the uniform resistance wire between ends Q and R to a point P where the reading on the galvanometer is zero.
What is an expression for the approximate length QP?
